entries.description: A three-lesbian separatist homestead on 45 acres in Saugerties, New York, working toward wheelchair accessibility, producing most of their own food, and offering summer herbal and healing intensives. Lesbians of all ages are welcome for visits up to five days.
entries.raw_text: ROWDYBUSH FARM (Susun Weed & Clove), 3136 Fishcreek Rd, Saugerties, NY 12477. Our dream is to be part of a network of SAFE SPACES for wimmin. Right now we are a hard working lesbian separatist homestead on an old blue stone quarry with a lovely, secluded pond. We provide almost all our own food with three large gardens, a solar greenhouse, dairy goats, chickens, ducks and fruit trees (to be planted this spring). We support the land partly by working outside jobs and partly by holding Herbal and Psychic Healing Intensives every summer. We are working on wheelchair accessibility for house and campsites. We welcome lesbians of all ages as visitors for up to five days, $2-5/day donation. We have/are: 3 lesbians, 45 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, wimmin living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative as 3 lesbians live and work on the land ('3 lesbians', 'wimmin living and working on the land'). Contact name taken from parenthetical after community name. Street address indicates land location. Accepted groups: Lesbian women ('lesbians of all ages'). Focuses: Disabled women ('working on wheelchair accessibility for house and campsites'), Lesbian separatism ('lesbian separatist homestead'), Farming/self-sufficiency ('homestead', 'provide almost all our own food'), Workshops/education ('holding Herbal and Psychic Healing Intensives every summer').

entries.description: A women's land community of 6 to 10 lesbians on 150 acres near Alpine, New York, investing in farming equipment and focusing on self-sufficiency. Welcomes lesbian visitors, prospective members, and girl children.
entries.raw_text: NORTHWOODS RD 1 Box 156, Alpine, NY 14805 (607)594-3536. (Between Ithaca & Watkins Glen, NY.) Northwoods is in its 6th year as womyn's land, now moving this spring to a more focused use of the land than just gardening and living. We're investing in farm equipment and need work energy. Healing is a focus of many of us. We need everyone here to be self sufficient and self motivated. We welcome: visitors (maybe), new members (perhaps, cautiously), girl children. We have/are: 6-10 lesbians, 150 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Rural route address copied to land address. num_residents is 6, the lower number of the range '6-10 lesbians'. Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative based on 6-10 resident lesbians living on the land. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (directory context, new members/visitors) and Girl children ('girl children'). Focus: Farming/self-sufficiency ('investing in farm equipment', 'need everyone here to be self sufficient').

entries.description: A 25-acre homestead in the mountains of West Virginia run by two lesbians who are farmers, carpenters, and woodworker/blacksmith. Welcomes lesbian visitors, apprentices, and girl children.
entries.raw_text: MISTY BOTTOMS FARM c/o Mimi & Judy, Rt 86 Box 15A, Jumping Branch, WV 25969. We are building a womyn's homestead on 25 acres in a hollow on a creek in the mountains of WV. Secluded land, access by foot or 4-wheel drive. We are carpenters and woodworker/blacksmith as well as farmers. Will teach skills to serious apprentices. Visitors welcome and expected to help (bring own food). We welcome: girl children and apprentices. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 25 acres, housing/permanent structure, electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Rural route address copied to land address. Type is Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('c/o Mimi & Judy', '2 lesbians'); taking apprentices and visitors does not make it Intentional Community/Cooperative because they are not actively recruiting permanent members to live there. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (directory context) and Girl children ('girl children'). Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency ('homestead', 'farmers') and Workshops/education ('Will teach skills to serious apprentices').

entries.description: A collective of seven lesbians on 40 acres in Holly Springs, Mississippi, striving for self-sufficiency. Welcomes lesbian women, non-lesbian women, and girl and boy children for short visits with work exchange or fee.
entries.raw_text: SILVER CIRCLE FARM c/o Gwen O Demeter, Box 100 Rt 5, Holly Springs, MS 38635. We are a collective of seven wimmin dedicated to caring for 40 acres and each other. We strive to tolerate our differences as well as enjoy them. We are striving toward self sufficiency. Visits require work exchange and/or cash for short stays. Longer visits/meals negotiable. Have communal kitchen. We are not separatists. We are spiritual, artistic, scientific, political, but most important we are loving wimmin trying to give each other space to grow! We welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, dogs (but only on leash). We have/are: 7 lesbians, 40 acres, permanent structures (in process), outdoor plumbing, electricity (also hook-ups for couple of RV's), camping space, woods, farm land, wimmin living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Rural route address copied to land address. Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('collective of seven wimmin', '7 lesbians... living and working on the land'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women (directory context/members), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children and Boy children ('girl and boy children'). Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency ('striving toward self sufficiency'), Spirituality/ritual ('We are spiritual'). Rejection of separatism noted ('We are not separatists').

entries.description: A community of four resident lesbians on 18 acres near Red Rock, Texas, developing a self-sufficient space with livestock, gardens, and a stained-glass and spinning workshop. Substance-free; welcomes lesbian visitors and girl children.
entries.raw_text: EARTH CURRENT FARM Rt 1 Box 137L, Red Rock, TX 78662 (512)764-2706. We are a family of 6 lesbians, 4 on the land. We are developing a self sufficient space 35 miles SE of Austin, that will provide most of our food and bring in at least part of our survival money. Our plans include chickens, goats, sheep, rabbits, a garden, orchard, and a stain-glass and spinning workshop. We welcome: girl children and dogs (maybe leashed). Visits limited to 2-3 days, $2 per person or work exchange, no drugs, alcohol or cigarrettes please. We have/are: 6 lesbians, 18 acres, 2 housing/permanent structures, electricity, camping space, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Rural route address copied to land address. num_residents is 4 ('family of 6 lesbians, 4 on the land'). Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('family of 6 lesbians', 4 living on land). Accepted groups: Lesbian women (directory context) and Girl children ('girl children'). Focuses: Recovery/substance-free ('no drugs, alcohol or cigarrettes please'), Farming/self-sufficiency ('developing a self sufficient space... that will provide most of our food', livestock, garden), Archives/cultural work ('stain-glass and spinning workshop').

entries.description: A couple in their 40s living on 13 forested acres near the Yuba River in California, seeking one to three semi-collective members. Welcomes new members, non-lesbian women, and girl and boy children.
entries.raw_text: CEDAR c/o Linda or Sara, PO Box 274, Camptonville, CA 95922. We are a couple in our 40's, vegies/non-smokers, living on 13 acres, deeply forested, sub-alpine beauty at 3200'. Looking for 1-3 semi-collective members, very hard to make a living locally, rural, quite isolated, wet winters, hot summers, near incredible Yuba River, other parcels for sale nearby and looking for lesbian buyers. We welcome: new members, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 13 acres, trailer, shed, electricity/well, camping space, woods, organic garden/ orchard, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: PO Box is not land address; land city inferred as Camptonville based on mailing city and nearby Yuba River. Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because although currently 2 lesbians, they are actively recruiting permanent members ('Looking for 1-3 semi-collective members'), fulfilling the two-woman rule exception. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (directory context/members), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children and Boy children ('girl and boy children'). No focuses meet the threshold ('vegies/non-smokers' does not meet substance-free; 'organic garden/ orchard' in questionnaire line alone is not a primary farming focus).
